title: An explicit non-collapsing facet of the 4 x 4 x 5 marginal cone
scope: An integral functional exposes a facet of the no-three-way-interaction marginal cone P^{4,4,5} (dimension 43 in a cone of dimension 44) whose five layers have pairwise distinct zero patterns, so it is not a pullback under any state maps to 4x4x4; refutes Eriksson-Fienberg-Rinaldo-Sullivant Conjecture 14.
source_targets: Eriksson-Fienberg-Rinaldo-Sullivant, J. Symbolic Comput. 41 (2006), Conjecture 14; arXiv:math/0405044 conj:col
substantive_reason: Refutes a named universal conjecture in algebraic statistics, open since 2004/2006 and restated as open later (Rinaldo 2006 thesis, Dobra et al.), with an explicit facet certificate; the tropical subdivision interpretation explains it but is derived here, not attributed.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded comparison by root ruling; reviewers held on Schroeter 2017/2018 enumeration (orbit counts, no representatives)
remaining_literature_limits: Schroeter enumeration of coarsest product subdivisions may contain this subdivision (no explicit match)
